newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND SLIPS AGAINST DOLLAR IN QUIET MARKET.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND SLIPS AGAINST DOLLAR IN QUIET MARKET.

text.p: The Egyptian pound lost against the dollar on Sunday in a quiet private sector market, bankers said.
"No one is buying or selling. There is no demand on the dollar," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3895 and 3.3930 pounds bid and 3.3915 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average exchange rate was 3.391875 bid and 3.394375 offered, compared to 3.390625 bid and 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average rate at midday as 3.389113 pounds buy and 3.394064 pounds sell.
